seedPhrase: A band known as the The Dawn-Sworn Salt-Bearers of the Living Stone
limerick:
The Dawn-Sworn Salt-Bearers, bold,
In the Living Stone, stories are told.
With a rhythm so deep,
The secrets they keep,
In a saga of silver and gold.

seedPhrase: A gathering of The Steadfast Tide-Turners of the Four Dawns
limerick:
The Tide-Turners gathered in light,
To stand for the Four Dawns so bright.
With steadfast resolve,
As the shadows dissolve,
They rose to confront the long night.

seedPhrase: The proudly The True-Bearing Root-Severers of the Four Dawns
limerick:
The True-Bearing Root-Severers stand,
With pride in the dawn's rising land.
The Four Dawns they claim,
With a fierce, holy name,
With a power both sturdy and grand.

seedPhrase: A gathering of The Horizon-True Root-Severers of the Rifted Hills
limerick:
The Root-Severers gathered in line,
To make the Rifted Hills shine.
With Horizon in sight,
They gathered by light,
In a gathering truly divine.

seedPhrase: The proudly The Open-Handed Shade-Dwellers of the Inland Reach
limerick:
The Shade-Dwellers, proud of their reach,
With open hands, lessons they teach.
In the inland domain,
They dwell in the shade,
With a spirit no shadow can breach.
